findings.summary: Name permitAuthorized is misleading: it is true whenever authorityCommit !== undefined, including null incomplete commits.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Rename or document the sentinel clearly (e.g. authorityCommitProvided) so maintainers do not read it as authorization success.

findings.summary: Converged CAS branch returns bag receipt without a comment linking it to kernel exact-replay.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Add a brief intent comment tying converged receipt materialization to findReplayReceipt / exact-replay contract.

findings.summary: Post-CAS committedReceipt cascade (cas || reload bag || local) has three arms with no justification comment.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Document when each arm is allowed after ok CAS, or collapse to a single authoritative source to avoid wrong-fallback edits.

findings.summary: issueOperationPermit operation fallback priority (offer then policy/human; kernelRule omitted) lacks a priority comment.
findings.acceptance_criteria: Document operation resolution priority across decision kinds in issuer code.
